items: Initial configuration checker used HID_SENSOR_ROTATION instead of the actual HID_SENSOR_DEVICE_ROTATION symbol. Its post-config failure is retained; the corrected complete profile passes.
Optional SYSTEM_REVOCATION_KEYS may be absent when its subsystem is disabled; the check accepts absence or an empty value, never an external file.

Python tar data filtering normalized one PowerPC self-test symlink, preserving its resolved target and every regular file byte. The first literal Git-blob audit rejected it. Two subsequent complete builds preserve all 91290 tracked paths exactly. The first build remains a disclosed normalized-link control.

The initial controller diagnostic arrays matched colon-style warnings only. The final audit also parses DTC parenthesized warnings: 219 compiler/doc warnings and 361 DT warnings. All 219 compiler/doc lines exactly match the prior full-build warning baseline; three earlier RMI documentation warnings are absent. No zero-warning claim is made.

Committed-archive verification caught the public verification certificate excluded by the repository-wide PEM ignore rule. Only this explicitly verified public certificate is force-added; private signing material remains absent.
